label: Catholic Church, Catechism of the Catholic…: CCC 199-200: 'I believe in God' is the first and most…
locator: CCC 199-200, this first affirmation of the Apostles' Creed is also the most fundamental
interpretation: CCC 199: '"I believe in God": this first affirmation of the Apostles' Creed is also the most fundamental ... "The faithful first profess their belief in God."' CCC 200: 'the confession of God's oneness ... is inseparable from the profession of God's existence and is equally fundamental.' It is the practice's account of its profession, not a report of believers' understanding.
attribution: The passage states that 'I believe in God' is the first and most fundamental affirmation of the creed, that the faithful first profess their belief in God, and that confessing God's oneness is inseparable from professing his existence, which is the premise.
